business_problem: Geely's user-data systems were becoming too complex for manual operations after multi-cloud growth, cross-site deployments, and the addition of Zeekr into the group. Topology was opaque, logs and metrics stayed siloed, alert storms produced hundreds of signals per incident, and mean-time-to-recovery frequently stretched into hours instead of the desired minutes.
solution_summary: Geely built an agentic-operations system on Alibaba Cloud around a four-layer model of data, modeling, diagnosis, and knowledge capture. Cloud Monitor 2.0 unifies metrics, logs, traces, events, and change records from scattered environments so operations intelligence starts from one data base instead of many fragmented sources. UModel then creates an operations digital twin by associating cloud resources, service topology, and Geely's internal business models in one context, which lets the intelligent agent follow impact paths and reason about likely root causes. On top of that model, STAROps automates evidence collection, filters large numbers of low-value alerts in seconds, and returns diagnosis paths or recovery ideas. Geely is also turning operational experience into reusable Skills, Runbooks, and healing commands so incident response becomes an asset the AI system can reuse instead of a one-time human effort.

solution_components.name: Cloud Monitor 2.0
solution_components.role: Provides the unified observability data base for AI-assisted operations analysis.

solution_components.name: UModel
solution_components.role: Builds the digital-twin model that links topology, resources, and business context for diagnosis.

solution_components.name: STAROps
solution_components.role: Runs agentic diagnosis, alert-noise reduction, and reusable operational skills.

data_flow: Observability and change data from Geely's systems is unified in Cloud Monitor 2.0, associated into a digital twin through UModel, and then analyzed by STAROps for evidence gathering, alert filtering, diagnosis, and runbook-based healing suggestions. The outputs are fed back into operations teams and reusable skills for future incidents.
business_outcome: Geely is replacing the old monitor-alarm-ticket chain with a data-driven operations loop that can model dependencies, diagnose incidents faster, and codify operational know-how for reuse. Teams now treat AI operations as a strategic platform capability rather than only a help-desk assistant.
